decisions.reason: The inertial measurement sensor module is an early-stage option in sensing with unresolved market demand, but shared modular resources keep the cost of maintaining it low.
The industrial AC voltage input module has its own page and fits the core power and automation range, so it is a more developed option with lower uncertainty.
The four-channel solid-state relay module fits the modular power and automation portfolio and remains an inexpensive option while its market value is still uncertain.
The server room monitoring sensor kit addresses a niche monitoring segment and is kept as an option, though its less central fit gives it a slightly higher drop probability.
